correctness.rationale: Read the frozen RESULT.md and checker.py. The within-layer Lipschitz constraints partition each clique potential into n unit cubes indexed by its unique minimizing vertex. Anchoring a_1=0 and retaining interlayer displacement delta is a determinant-1 coordinate change. For fixed within-layer shapes u,v, admissible delta has length 2-(max_i(u_i-v_i)-min_i(u_i-v_i)). If minimizing indices coincide, the difference array has one zero plus n-1 independent triangular U-V variables, yielding expected interval length 2J_{n-1}; if distinct it has independent -U and +U endpoints and n-2 triangular variables, yielding 2[J_{n-2}-(1-2^{-(n-1)})/(n-1)]. Sum n equal and n(n-1) unequal index pairs to derive exact formula. Laplace expansion J_m=sqrt(pi/(2m))+O(m^-3/2) proves asserted polynomial asymptotic. Independently enumerated lattice potentials and exact Ehrhart leading coefficients for n=2,3, matching V_2=16/3, V_3=49/5. The full formula is analytic, finite tests supplemental; anchored coordinate normalization essential.
